policies.title: Policies
policies.exec_tier_desc: How far the agent may go on its own before it stops to ask you. Applies to the next tool call — no restart needed.
policies.exec_tier_applied: Tier applied. It takes effect on the next tool call.
policies.exec_tier_plan_desc: Read-only planning. Nothing that changes anything runs — the agent explores, asks, and writes a plan. When you approve the plan, this conversation switches straight into building.
policies.exec_tier_ask_desc: Every mutating tool call — commands, file writes, deletions, credentials, MCP, browser — asks first; read-only tools still run freely.
policies.exec_tier_auto_desc: Tools run automatically; only irreversible operations (deletions, credential writes, disbanding a team, destructive MCP tools) ask first. The default.
policies.exec_tier_full_desc: Never asks. The catastrophic-command floor (fork bombs, rm -rf, device wipes) still holds — no tier can disable it.
policies.exec_tier_floor_note: The sandbox command floor holds under every tier.
policies.exec_tier_full_confirm_body: Aleph will run every tool — commands, file writes, deletions, credential access — without ever asking you first. The catastrophic-command floor (fork bombs, rm -rf /, device wipes) still holds: no tier can disable it.
policies.mode_chat_desc: Lightweight conversation. Heavy tool families (desktop, browser, media, teams, automation) stay discoverable but off the initial surface.
policies.mode_work_desc: Multi-step productivity work with the full standard tool surface. The default.
policies.mode_code_desc: Software development. Dev tools carry full schemas; desktop/media families move behind tool search.
policies.mode_note: Modes shape the tool surface, not permissions — the execution tier still governs approvals. A switch takes effect from the next turn.
policies.mode_global_desc: The default mode for sessions without their own override. Shapes the tool presentation surface only — never permissions.
policies.mode_applied: Global mode applied. Sessions with their own override keep it; others pick this up on their next turn.
policies.grants_desc: Calls you allowed without being asked again. "Session" lasts until the conversation ends; "Always" survives restarts until you revoke it here.
policies.grants_empty: Nothing is standing — every gated call still asks.
policies.grants_revoked: Revoked. The next call of this action asks again.
policies.tool_permissions_advanced_desc: An explicit entry here wins over the tier preset above. Tools you leave alone follow the tier.
policies.default_permission_desc: Applied to tools without specific overrides
policies.changes_note: Changes will take effect on next agent run.
policies.saved_note: Saved. Changes will take effect on next agent run.
policies.allow_analytics_desc: Send anonymous usage data to improve Aleph
policies.analytics_info: Analytics include: feature usage, performance metrics, and crash reports. No personal data, conversation content, or API keys are collected.
policies.think_note: Reasoning tokens bill at the output rate, so depth is the biggest per-turn cost lever. Not every model accepts every rung — core clamps to the nearest one the target model supports. Takes effect from the next turn.
policies.think_off_desc: No extended reasoning. Fastest and cheapest; sent as an explicit disable, because several model families think by default when the field is simply omitted.
policies.think_minimal_desc: A brief pass before answering. The shipped default where a level is set at all.
policies.think_low_desc: A little room to work through the question.
policies.think_medium_desc: Balanced — worth it for multi-step work with real branching.
policies.think_high_desc: Detailed reasoning. Noticeably slower and more expensive; reserve it for genuinely hard turns.
policies.think_xhigh_desc: The deepest setting, and only some models offer it — elsewhere core clamps down to what the model supports.
policies.memory_note: This governs what gets injected into the prompt, not what the conversation can do: the memory tools stay callable and anything learned here is still recorded. Takes effect from the next turn.
policies.memory_on_desc: Fold curated memory, the note index and per-query recall into this conversation's prompt.
policies.memory_off_desc: Inject none of them — a clean room. The model is told memory was withheld rather than left to conclude it forgot; tools and writes are untouched.

route.title: Model Routing
route.description: Choose how requests split between on-machine and cloud models. Switching takes effect on your next message — no restart.
route.mode_auto_desc: Keep the configured failover order. The smart default — local and cloud are peers, ordered by your provider config.
route.mode_local_desc: Only on-machine endpoints (e.g. http://localhost:11434). Cloud is dropped — for offline or sensitive work.
route.mode_cloud_desc: Prefer public-API flagship models. Local stays as an ungated last-resort degrade.
route.allow_escalation_desc: If no local provider succeeds, ask before trying a cloud provider as a last resort. Off: cloud is never used in this mode.
route.health_probe_desc: Seconds between re-dials of a provider whose circuit is open. Off by default — a probe is a real, paid request. Leave blank (or 0) to keep it off. A healthy provider is never probed, and a provider you disabled is never dialled.
route.applied: Applied — your next message uses this route.
route.preferred_providers_desc: Optional. Pin which configured endpoint each tier dials first — the chosen provider jumps to the front of its tier. Leave on “Configured order” to keep your provider order.
route.no_providers: No configured providers in this tier.
route.load_balance_desc: How requests spread across providers within the same tier. Ordered keeps your configured order; Usage-based spreads by remaining rpm/tpm headroom and de-prioritises saturated providers; Cost-aware prefers the cheapest provider first (unpriced local models count as free).
route.rate_limits_desc: Optional per-provider soft ceilings (LiteLLM-style). Used by the Usage-based strategy. Leave blank for unlimited on that axis.
